modelDescription: Barrel features a full length ejector shroud only. Full length ejector shroud. All barrels are constructed with a wide top rib longitudinally serrated to present a glare-free surface. The cushioned grips are constructed of live rubber with polished Goncalo Alves wood inserts. Interchangeable front sight, adjustable rear sight.
